stage.legend: Where is your project right now?

A.title: I have Figma files,design assets ready. At least a brand book and some specs.
A.hint: Full build in Next.js or Nuxt — components, database, API wiring.

B.title: I have a raw product concept or a business idea.
B.hint: We validate and shape it into wireframes, a sitemap and a locked spec.

C.title: I have a live product that needs more dev power or speed.
C.hint: Codebase cleanup, database tuning, performance and integrations.

D.title: I want to automate some parts of my business with custom AI tools or workflow automations.
D.hint: LLM pipelines, n8n / Make workflows, internal dashboards.

E.title: I just need a simple, fast website or landing page.
E.hint: 1–2 pages with a contact form and social links, in 2–3 days.

massMarket.title: A sleek 1–2 page site, live in 2–3 days.
massMarket.body: We build a 1–2 page landing page with an integrated contact form and social links, delivered in 2–3 days. Our lightest entry tier.

fullStack.title: Full-stack build from your designs.
fullStack.body: Your Figma becomes a working product: a component front end in Next.js or Nuxt, database and API integration.

blueprint.title: Scope & AI blueprinting.
blueprint.body: Fast wireframes, a generated sitemap and a locked functional spec — so the build starts from a clear plan.

refactor.title: Modernisation & refactoring.
refactor.body: .NET / Node / Nest cleanup, Postgres optimisation, a real performance boost and third-party integrations.

automation.title: AI engineering.
automation.body: Custom LLM pipelines, n8n / Make workflows and internal dashboards wired to your systems.
